title: Visual Parallel Search: Learning to Search High-Resolution Images with Parallel Tile Inspection and Adaptive Zoom
abstract: arXiv:2609.37002v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-resolution visual question answering often fails because a multimodal model does not acquire the small, spatially localized evidence needed to answer a question. Sequential zooming can recover detail, but it asks the main model to choose a region before obtaining a reliable overview. We introduce VPS, a visual parallel-search framework in which a main agent first invokes grid_search to inspect image tiles in parallel with question-conditioned sub-agents, and then adaptively invokes zoom_in PSisual Parallel Search improves mean accuracy over dedicated zoom-only search in 14 of 15 same-model comparisons, with gains up to 8.0 points and especially strong improvements for smaller main models. ZoomBench retains an approximately 3.2-point gain at every tested size. We further develop a supervision pipeline with hint-free verification and a paired role-specific GRPO surrogate for learning the controller and tile-reader roles. SFT improve

translated_title: 视觉并行搜索：通过并行图块检查与自适应缩放学习搜索高分辨率图像
translated_abstract: 高分辨率视觉问答常常失败，原因在于多模态模型未能获取回答问题所需的、空间上局部化的小证据。顺序缩放可以恢复细节，但它要求主模型在获得可靠的全局概览之前就先选择一个区域。我们提出了VPS，一个视觉并行搜索框架：主智能体首先调用grid_search，通过问题条件化的子智能体并行检查图像图块，然后自适应地调用zoom_in。视觉并行搜索在15组同模型对比中的14组里，平均准确率超越了专用的纯缩放搜索方法，提升最高达8.0个百分点，且对较小的主模型改进尤为显著。在ZoomBench上，所有测试尺寸下均保持了约3.2个百分点的增益。我们进一步开发了一个带有无提示验证的监督流程，以及一个成对的角色特定GRPO替代目标，用于学习控制器和图块读取器两个角色。
tldr: 提出视觉并行搜索框架VPS，通过并行图块检查与自适应缩放搜索高分辨率图像，在15组同模型对比中的14组超越纯缩放搜索方法，准确率提升最高达8.0个百分点，并通过无提示验证和角色特定GRPO训练控制器与图块读取器。
en_tdlr: We propose Visual Parallel Search (VPS), a framework that searches high-resolution images via parallel question-conditioned tile inspection and adaptive zoom, outperforming zoom-only search in 14 of 15 same-model comparisons with accuracy gains up to 8.0 points, trained through hint-free verification and role-specific GRPO for controller and tile-reader roles.
